label: Net benefit at a threshold probability t equals the prevalence times the true positive rate, minus one minus the prevalence, times the false positive rate, times t over one minus t
The net benefit of treating everyone equals the prevalence minus one minus the prevalence times t over one minus t
Treat when the disease probability times the net benefit of treating a diseased patient exceeds one minus the disease probability times the net loss of treating a healthy patient
The threshold probability equals the net loss of treating a healthy patient, divided by the sum of that loss and the net benefit of treating a diseased patient
